string.name: addon_cloud_source_failed

string.name: addon_cloud_upload_failed
string.value: Upload or remote verification did not complete. Check the network, app folder permissions and files with the same name. Check OneDrive before retrying. The local original was kept.

string.name: addon_cloud_title
string.value: OneDrive recording archive

string.name: addon_cloud_setup
string.value: Register your own app in Microsoft Entra. Enable “Allow public client flows” and grant the Microsoft Graph delegated permission Files.ReadWrite.AppFolder. Single-tenant apps also need the directory (tenant) ID; multi-tenant and personal account registrations can leave it blank. No client secret, full-drive access or offline access is required.
